_comment: Edit this to re-cut the book. 'order' sets both the section order in the index and the precedence when sorting. 'title_match' is tried against the recipe title and the first line of the caption, which is where the dish name lives. 'any_match' is tried against the whole caption and is only for signals that are properties rather than dish names, like macros. Title matches always beat anywhere matches. Anything unmatched lands in 'fallback'.

blurbs.sweets: Desserts, frozen things, cheesecakes and the protein ones that still count as pudding.
blurbs.light: The diet and weight-loss pile. High protein, lower calorie, macros usually included.
blurbs.comfort: Mains and the indulgent stuff you saved because it looked unreasonable.
blurbs.side: Dips, sauces, dressings, sides and party food.
blurbs.bread: Bread, dough, tortillas and the low-carb bread experiments.

any_match.light: \b(macros per|calories per|\d+\s*g protein|protein per serving|\d+\s*cal\b|high in protein)\b
